propositions: Bug fixes that declare non-test file_impact must escalate from the light advisory tier to the full blocking LLM review rubric, with escalation applied uniformly across precheck det_blocking, route_criteria tier selection, and batch-runner fan-in.

Gerrit DET criterion must block oversized bug fixes (>150 non-test lines) lacking a current or code-drifted attestation by reading the plan-review attestation cross-host via opcert verification with compute_validity freshness validation.

Plan-review attestation verification must use cross-host op-cert machinery (opcert_from_record + trusted_env_keyring + verify_opcert) never own-env plan_review_status, with support for foreign pinned environments and rejection of legacy HMAC records.

Attestation verdict classification must map compute_validity plan-review-reachable literals and cross-host op-cert verdicts into ACCEPTED (certified/stale-code/stale-head), FLAG (all others except unavailable), and INFRA-FAIL-OPEN (unavailable/error/unknown-future).
Non-test line classification (tests/** and conftest.py excluded) and the 150-line threshold must be captured in a single shared constant imported by both B2 criterion and backtest script.

Backtest over 113 historical bug-fix commits must flag exactly the 13 adjudicated-substantive commits and zero mechanical false positives, validating the non-test classification rule against the planning corpus.
